Hehe my bad for the bad review. Shoganai :p Sorry to ask but I wondered if you had the time to look into it ? I would like to fix this for 0.5 . I haven't been able to test the multigrid yet but working towards it.

Sorry this is taking so long.
Now I am looking into this issue and I think there are multiple causes.

The assumption is that I was correct in using default_grid when ext_multigrid is disabled.

I think the problems are as follows: 

1.When split tabs, set the tabline height (= 1) to [firstwin->w_winrow], so in mouse_find_win(), which is called when a cell is clicked, the row that is clicked is subtracted by [firstwin->w_winrow].
As a result, when checking the text in the clicked cell, the coordinates were wrong and the text in the clicked area could not be obtained.

2. even after fixing the above problem, it seems to be impossible to open and close the folds once you move to the second tab.

I am currently looking into the second problem, but have no idea how to fix the two issues.

I will continue to look into this issue, but it may take a very long time, so you can go ahead and solve it.
If I can fix it and no PR has been issued for this issue, I will issue one.
